arms.e2b_candidates: endpoints 352/704/1056 plus at most one preregistered interior seal
arms.e4b_product_reference: Plan 31 step-704 E4B checkpoint (tree c624ff5a558ceb9135088e43155377576824b97b950bb4a2be6a5753bd98641f) converted to MLX BF16 by the same converter from its sealed GCS seal (Plan 32's frozen parent baseline); a separate product baseline, not a causal control
arms.stock_e2b: pinned revision 3e22461f converted to MLX BF16 with the same converter

definitions.balance: count(APPROVED) - count(REJECTED) for one judge over an arm's outputs
definitions.major_error: manual audit: omitted/misattributed visible participant or message, or unsupported literal content, in any REJECTED full or image_only output

exposed20.rule: first 20 rows of the frozen v3 validation manifest order

gates.beats_stock: selected BF16 E2B balance > stock E2B balance for both judges on the 360 selection outputs
gates.e4b_noninferiority: for each judge: selected balance >= E4B balance - 18 over 360, and >= E4B balance - 6 in each of full and image_only
gates.exposed20_screen: candidate eligible unless its runaways exceed stock E2B or its 120-output balance is lower than stock by more than 6 for either judge
gates.material_local_benefit: median full-mode latency <= 0.70x E4B OR peak MLX memory <= 0.70x E4B, same host and runtime
gates.no_major_error_increase: selected major errors <= stock E2B major errors
gates.no_mode_regression: for every mode and judge, selected balance >= stock balance - 3 (of 60)
gates.no_new_runaway: selected runaways <= stock E2B runaways and <= E4B reference runaways
gates.otherwise: record KILL (E2B rejected for E4B) or inconclusive with the next falsifying experiment; thresholds never move after this freeze
gates.selection_rule: among eligible candidates passing all gates, highest mean two-judge balance; ties -> fewer runaways -> lower median tokens -> earlier step
gates.six_bit_tolerance: 6-bit balance >= BF16 balance - 9 per judge, no new runaway, and no mode lower by more than 3; else keep BF16 or KILL

interior_seal_rule: Among seals 88/176/264/440/528/616/792/880/968, take the one with the lowest mean six-mode validation-60 loss; include it only if that mean is lower than every endpoint's mean and its segment has no nonfinite event; ties -> earliest.

judging.blinding: one candidate per call; no arm, checkpoint, model, or mode identity; no reference output
judging.instructions_shown: canonical full v3 system+user bytes of the row (before mode omission)

loss_panels.mode_panel: validation-60 x six modes at every 88-step seal
loss_panels.role: diagnostic only; never a quality claim

runtime_abi.hf_mps: optional mechanism diagnosis only; never mixed into paired claims
runtime_abi.precision: unquantized BF16 for selection; 6-bit only for the selected checkpoint

sealed_test: unopened; no Plan 33 step may read it

selection_panel.source: Plan 31 validation-freeze v1, same panel Plan 32 uses for E4B
